title: Wrong/Damaged Item Delivered - Customer Wants Refund

raw_content.initial_message: My order arrived but it’s the wrong item AND the box is damaged. I don’t want a replacement — I want a refund.
raw_content.context: Order delivered with wrong item/damage. Policy: apologize and gather order details. Replacement is the default resolution; refund is allowed only after return pickup is initiated (or item is returned) within 7 days of delivery. Ask for photos if required, but don’t demand them aggressively. Offer expedited replacement or return pickup. Set clear timeline for refund processing once return is in motion.

learning_objectives: Handle delivery issues with empathy and clear resolution options
Follow return/refund policy steps without escalating
Offer expedited replacement/return pickup and set expectations
correct_sop_steps: Verify order details (order ID, delivery date, item expected vs received)
If policy requires, request photos of label/item/box politely to confirm wrong/damaged
Explain options: expedited replacement or return pickup + refund after pickup/return initiated
Initiate return pickup (or provide return label) and share timeline for refund processing
If customer insists on refund today, explain constraint and offer supervisor escalation if needed; set next update time
common_mistakes: Refusing refund without offering return pickup steps
Failing to offer expedited replacement/return pickup
sticky_notes: KEY: Offer action steps (pickup/label) before policy debate.
TRAP: Don’t sound like you’re doubting the customer—ask for photos politely.
HINT: If they refuse replacement, focus on return pickup + refund timeline.

must_demonstrate: Clear options offered (replacement vs refund flow)
bonus_points: Provides a single concise message summarizing the plan

escalation_triggers: Accusatory tone implying customer is lying
customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will accept the refund process if you initiate return pickup immediately and give a clear refund timeline
